findings.title: Debug mode enabled
findings.message: Debug mode may expose internals or interactive execution in production.
findings.remediation: Make production fail closed and enable debug only in an explicit local environment.

fix_scaffold.summary: Turn off debug mode in application code.
fix_scaffold.review_note: Drive debug from environment configuration instead of a constant.

findings.title: Outbound request without timeout
findings.message: An outbound request has no explicit deadline and can exhaust workers or connections.
findings.remediation: Set connect and read deadlines, bound retries, and test dependency failure.

findings.title: Insecure secret fallback default
findings.message: A hardcoded fallback default is provided for an environment secret.
findings.remediation: Remove the hardcoded fallback string; require explicit environment configuration.

findings.title: Express app without helmet
findings.message: Express app is created without security middleware (helmet).
findings.remediation: Add app.use(helmet()) to set security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, etc.).

findings.title: Express auth route without rate limiting
findings.message: An authentication-sensitive Express route is registered without visible rate-limiting middleware.
findings.remediation: Add rate-limiting middleware (e.g. express-rate-limit) or verify the gateway throttles these routes.

findings.title: FastAPI app routes without visible rate limiting
findings.message: FastAPI routes are registered without visible rate-limiting middleware or dependencies.
findings.remediation: Add rate limiting (for example slowapi or gateway throttling) and cover authentication-sensitive routes with tests asserting 429 responses.

limitations: Fast heuristic scan; confirm every finding.
No runtime reachability or dependency CVE database.
